jobs.description: About Dropzone AI Dropzone’s mission is to scale cybersecurity beyond human limits, and augment every single human security engineer/analyst with an army of AI security specialists. Humans alone cannot sufficiently protect our digital future, and AI augmentation is the only way for defenders to reclaim the high ground. We are an award winning company disrupting the $200B+ cybersecurity market. Powered by Gen AI advancements, our technology offloads repetitive day-to-day work and frees human analysts to focus on real threats and higher-value projects. We are venture-backed, and our team has a rare blend of deep experience across cybersecurity, AI/ML, and SaaS product development. Join us if you want to be on the ground floor of using Gen AI to transform cyber defense. Learn more at www.dropzone.ai. About the role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the two squads that decide whether Dropzone works on day one of a deployment and whether it keeps working at scale. The Integrations squad gets every eligible signal source into the AI SOC Team complete, deduplicated, and once, so no alert goes uninvestigated because of a data gap. The Platform squad makes connecting and administering Dropzone something customers do themselves, including tenant management for MSSPs, access control, audit trail, case management, and governed response actions. These squads share one outcome: the time from contract signature to trusted, self-serve coverage of a customer's full signal estate. Today that number depends too heavily on our sales engineers and support team. Your job is to make it a product number. This is a senior individual contributor role embedded in product/engineering trios. You own the customer problem, the business outcome, prioritization, and the honest answer to whether we succeeded. You will not be handed a roadmap. You'll help discover the problem, define the right solution, and own whether it lands. You'll report to the Head of Product. What you'll do • Serve as product lead in two cross-functional trios alongside engineering and design, owning the customer problem, business outcome, and prioritization for each squad. • Lead continuous discovery with SOC analysts, SOC managers, MSSP operators, and platform administrators. Nothing executes without human-defined authorization and a verifiable trail. • Ship in small increments, measure impact, and adjust. Every release carries the problem it solves, the outcome it supports, a metric to watch, and a named validation owner. • Contribute to the product operating model: help define what good discovery, prioritization, and release look like at Dropzone. Requirements • 6+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning platform, integrations, or infrastructure-adjacent product where the customer is technical and the failure modes are quiet. • Experience shipping in security, observability, data infrastructure, or an adjacent domain. jobs.description: About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
